D: Peter's life falls apart as a black alien suit brings out his dark side and new villains appear.
P: Serve dessert when Peter takes MJ to the fancy French restaurant to propose.
S: Harry and MJ making an omelette together
Small omelettes of eggs, cheese and chives baked in muffin tins at 180C for 15 minutes.
the Sandman rising out of the sand
Butter browned until nutty, cooled and mixed with flour and brown sugar, rolled into logs, coated in raw sugar, sliced and baked at 170C for 15 minutes.
Jazz club fig and goat's cheese bites
Peter's black suit dance at the jazz club

Fresh figs halved and topped with soft goat's cheese, honey, walnuts and thyme, flashed under the grill and laid out on black trays. Halve 8 ripe figs and lay cut side up on a tray. Top each with a teaspoon of soft goat's cheese from 150g and a walnut half. Drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and grill on high for 3 minutes until the cheese is warm and just colouring. Scatter with thyme leaves and cracked pepper and serve on a black tray with a few prosciutto ribbons alongside.
M: Peter planning to propose at the French restaurant

Coq au vin of chicken, bacon, mushrooms and red wine simmered 90 minutes, with buttery mash. Brown 1kg chicken thighs and 150g diced bacon. Add 250g mushrooms and cook until golden, then pour in 500ml red wine and enough water to cover. Simmer for 90 minutes until rich and glossy. Serve over mash from 1kg potatoes and plenty of butter.
Aunt May's lemon thyme roast chicken
Aunt May giving Peter advice at her kitchen table

Whole chicken rubbed with butter, lemon and thyme and roasted golden, with crispy roast potatoes and a rich gravy from the pan juices. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter, the zest of 1 lemon, thyme and salt, put the lemon inside and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potato chunks for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil for 50 minutes. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices, add 300ml chicken stock and simmer, scraping the pan, until thick.
W: the ring at the French restaurant
Vanilla custard baked at 150C for 35 minutes in a water bath, chilled, sugar torched on top.
K: Fresh raspberry purée and a splash of lemon topped with chilled prosecco in tall flutes, with floating raspberries. Blend 150g raspberries with 2 tbsp caster sugar and 1 tbsp lemon juice, then push through a sieve. Spoon 1 tbsp purée into each of 4 chilled flutes. Slowly top with chilled prosecco from a 750ml bottle, letting it fizz up and settle. Drop 2 raspberries into each glass. For a booze-free version, top with sparkling apple juice.

s.note: Harry and MJ making an omelette together
s.how: Whisk 8 eggs with 100ml milk, 100g grated cheddar, snipped chives and salt. Butter a 12-hole muffin tin and pour the mix in evenly. Bake at 180C for 15 minutes until puffed and just set. Ease out with a knife and serve warm.

s.note: the Sandman rising out of the sand
s.how: Brown 200g butter until nutty and cool until firm. Beat with 150g brown sugar, then mix in 280g flour. Roll into logs, coat in raw sugar and chill for an hour. Slice into rounds and bake at 170C for 15 minutes until golden and sandy.

m.note: Peter planning to propose at the French restaurant
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs and 150g diced bacon. Add 250g mushrooms and cook until golden, then pour in 500ml red wine and enough water to cover. Simmer for 90 minutes until rich and glossy. Serve over mash from 1kg potatoes and plenty of butter.

w.note: the ring at the French restaurant
w.how: Heat 600ml cream with a split vanilla bean until steaming. Whisk 6 yolks with 80g sugar, pour in the cream and strain into 4 ramekins. Bake in a water bath at 150C for 35 minutes and chill. Sprinkle with sugar and torch until amber and crackly.
